description_en: Queries the log store information of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium, such as log storage capacity and storage duration of logs
description_zh: 例如日志存储容量、日志存储时长
name: DescribeSlsLogstoreInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

LogStore.description_en: The log store that is associated with Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium
LogStore.description_zh: DDoS高防服务对接的日志库

Project.description_en: The log project that is associated with Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium
Project.description_zh: DDoS高防服务对接的日志项目

Quota.description_en: The available log storage capacity. Unit: bytes
Quota.description_zh: 可用的日志存储容量。单位：Byte

Ttl.description_en: The storage duration of logs. Unit: days

Used.description_en:
The used storage capacity. Unit: bytes.

The statistics from Simple Log Service have a delay of approximately two hours
Used.description_zh:
已经使用的存储容量。单位：Byte。

日志服务的统计结果约有两个小时的延迟
